purpose: Controlled local contact-shadow A/B and cache invalidation verification; not a sustained GPU benchmark
controlledDifference: Only local shadow intensity changes from 0 to 0.9; sun, lights, camera, materials and exposure stay fixed
limits: CPU submission timings do not measure asynchronous GPU completion.
Only environmental casters are cached; enemies retain the original sun shadow path.
Door/breakable invalidation is capped at 8 Hz with one subsequent-frame presentation delay.
Initial local-shadow submission cost in the final test was 5.6 ms CPU; stable frames do not redraw these maps.
